verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents an official CLI covering scraping, crawling, exports, schedules, and dedicated APIs. Its llms.txt docs list specific subcommands such as `scrapingbee crawl` and `scrapingbee schedule`, and a probe confirms an official GitHub repo (ScrapingBee/scrapingbee-cli). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI in use, and scheduling is noted as a gated advanced feature.
